scope: Polish AED source audit against the merged implementation plan and live provider endpoints. This is not a complete inventory of every AED database in Poland.

storage.canonical: JSON/GeoJSON/CSV snapshots and public export contract
storage.query_index: SQLite R*Tree for bounded spatial lookup; JSON files alone do not provide a spatial index
storage.history: Changed validated raw snapshots retained by SHA-256 under data/raw/history/<source>

sources.name: OpenAEDMap / OpenStreetMap Polska
sources.notes: National OSM baseline. Alternative OSM mirrors and Geoportal are the same underlying community dataset, not independent corroboration.

sources.name: Miasto Krosno (dane.gov.pl #3624)
sources.notes: Live catalogue discovery follows resource pagination and selects latest CSV. 21 raw records; matches retain provenance.

sources.name: Miasto Legionowo (dane.gov.pl #40593)
sources.notes: 24 official CSV records, CC0 verified from dataset40593. Mixed health dataset: resource title must match AED/defibrillator, so newer pharmacy feeds are excluded. No field access/check evidence inferred. Source has no device ID; stable hash of name and address; renames need identity review. Distinct devices at same coordinates retained.

limitations: No claim that all possible Polish sources have been integrated. Several providers need credentials, permissions or a confirmed export endpoint.
Publisher and reuse review is still required before submitting any package to dane.gov.pl; metadata explicitly labels draft status.
CRU/BZP/TED procurement notices are leads for independent placement confirmation, never active AED markers.
Source refresh needs the server running; persistent scheduler state resumes overdue work after restart. An external process manager should keep the server alive.

catalogue_search_at_audit.result: Found municipal resources for Krosno, Przemyśl, Marki, Legionowo, plus Gdańsk bus-fleet context. Warsaw API docs found separately by AED query. No claim of exhaustive national coverage.
